unmodified_requirements: inherit all base requirements; no source, target, question, hypothesis, estimand or sensitivity changes

patch.value: at least one quantitatively observed insulin use or independence, HbA1c, CGM time in range, or severe hypoglycemia endpoint attributed by the report to the fixed target population, not solely a contextual cohort
identifiable prespecified target population in the report; simple source-stated attribution suffices without detailed verified cohort or overlap mapping
stated overall follow-up for the fixed target population at least nominal 12 months including day 365 or week 52; later-only accepted; no endpoint-specific horizon or treatment-anchor requirement

value: observed insulin-independent participant count, including explicitly reported zero
onset and duration when any independence occurred; justified field-level not_applicable when explicit reviewed evidence states nobody achieved independence
observed nominal month-12 or day-365 or week-52
time anchored to each participant's first administration of the cell-containing intervention

value.implant: first implantation of the cell-containing intervention; not preparatory empty-device implantation
value.later_administrations: record separately; never reset time zero
value.incomplete_or_conflicting_anchor_review: unknown predicate, unless another failure is independently proven
value.confirmed_omission_of_first_versus_repea: unmet predicate with TIMING_UNREPORTED after complete review

patch.value: retain first and repeat administration dates and source-stated anchors; fixed horizon uses first cell administration only; no silent or calculated anchor resetting

value.reported: preserve source-supported value regardless of report labels, including zero, false, unfavorable outcomes and facts proving failure
value.other_statuses: null value plus status, locator or access log, review scope and justification
value.zero_independence_onset_and_duration: not_applicable only with explicit source evidence that nobody achieved independence during the observation interval through the fixed horizon; zero independent at month 12 alone does not rule out earlier episodes; outcome count, denominator, definition and horizon remain mandatory

patch.value: endpoint explicitly anchored to something other than the participant's first administration of the cell-containing intervention, including a later treatment
complete review confirms screen endpoint or overall follow-up belongs solely to a contextual cohort rather than the frozen target; unmet affected predicate
source-stated attribution of screen endpoint or overall follow-up to the fixed target cannot be adjudicated; unknown affected predicate
